title: Compile upgrade brief and changelog synchronization playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a consolidated playbook and one-page upgrade brief that standardizes how we draft, review, and publish internal and customer-facing changelogs for upcoming Redwood feature releases. Deliverables: 1) a templated customer upgrade brief (one-page) targeted at engineering/product customers describing behavior changes, migration steps, rollout timeline, and rollback instructions; 2) an internal signoff checklist for PM/Design/Eng/Security/Legal; 3) an automated changelog export spec for Console and public API docs; 4) gating criteria and escalation matrix for high-impact changes.
acceptance_criteria: One-page customer upgrade brief template stored in Drive and linked from Console docs
Internal signoff checklist created and approved by Eng lead, Design lead, and Legal
Changelog export spec committed to docs repo with sample JSON schema and example PRs
At least two upcoming releases (staging and prod) use the new process in pilot
Stakeholder training session scheduled and recorded in Confluence
